title: Spiral Harmonic Products
summary: Motivated by the systematic study of spiral minimal products, we consider harmonic maps obtained by coupling two spherical eigenmaps through a profile curve in $\mathbb S^3$, with a doubly warped product metric on the source. The source warps are independent of the profile magnitudes. This gives two complementary problems: reconstructing a compatible source metric from prescribed profile or source data, and finding closed profiles when the source metric is fixed.
